technical_and_design_decisions: Treat U3 and U4 as duplicate statements of one Redis field-value counter aggregation feature, implementing the feature once.
Upgrade the existing Reactor dependency to Reactor 2.0 RC1 without introducing a broader Spring Framework or Java platform migration.

Implement the reactor stream-processor plugin using the existing module/plugin conventions, requiring only the processor class as the minimum configuration and supporting additional settings through standard module option commands.
Implement Redis aggregation using Redis hash field counters and atomic increment operations so that repeated ingestion updates the existing aggregate safely.
Expose the HTTP source maximum message size through servers.yml, retaining the existing 1 MB value as the default for backward compatibility.
Implement the RxJava processor as an adapter around the existing stream-processing and message-conversion APIs, with lifecycle and error handling consistent with other processor modules.
Move Hadoop-specific tests and supporting configuration into a separate test project while preserving their existing execution behavior.

Implement XD plus YARN acceptance tests against EC2 using automated provisioning or an existing project harness, with tests focused on representative basic XD features rather than exhaustive cluster validation.
Include unit tests, integration tests, acceptance-test updates, documentation changes, and build verification within the estimates.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD codebase, build, module APIs, Redis support, Hadoop test project structure, and YARN deployment tooling are available and buildable before work begins.

The previous field-value counter aggregation specification is available from repository history or an equivalent local copy; no redesign beyond identifying and closing implementation gaps is required.
U3 and U4 have identical scope and do not require two independent implementations.
Reactor 2.0 RC1 remains compatible with the existing supported Java version and does not require a wholesale rewrite of application code.
Required Redis, Hadoop, YARN, and EC2 environments, credentials, images, and network access are available; provisioning new cloud accounts or resolving provider outages is excluded.
The EC2 acceptance suite can run on every build cycle using an existing or modestly extended test harness; extensive optimization of cloud cost or runtime is excluded.
Reference documentation is maintained in the existing project documentation format and does not require a new documentation platform.
The estimate represents one developer's hands-on effort in workdays, excluding elapsed waiting time for external reviews, infrastructure availability, and third-party releases.
Code review and merge coordination are limited to preparing the changes and addressing normal review feedback; major requirement changes are excluded.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing module, Reactor, Redis, Hadoop, YARN, HTTP source, build, and documentation structures; reconcile the user stories with current behavior; define interfaces, configuration points, test boundaries, and implementation sequencing.
Update dependency declarations and compatibility code, resolve API or package changes, adjust affected modules and tests, and verify the complete build against Reactor 2.0 RC1.

Implement the processor module/plugin configuration and runtime wiring so a processor class is sufficient for a minimal declaration; add support for standard module option commands and additional processor configuration; provide validation, lifecycle handling, unit tests, and integration coverage.

Port the prior aggregation specification, identify missing behavior, implement Redis-backed field counter updates and message handling, add configuration and error handling, and create unit and integration tests for initialization, repeated updates, multiple fields, and persistence across ingestion.

activities.activity_name: Aggregation documentation and specification gap updates
activities.activity_description: Document the Redis aggregation module, input and output semantics, Redis key and field behavior, configuration options, operational considerations, and any resolved gaps from the previous implementation specification.

Create or adapt a separate project for Hadoop-specific tests and dependencies, move test sources and resources, update build and execution configuration, remove the unwanted DIRT dependency, and verify that Eclipse classpath generation and normal builds remain correct.

activities.activity_name: XD plus YARN on EC2 acceptance coverage
activities.activity_description: Extend the acceptance-test harness for EC2-based YARN deployment, implement setup and teardown handling, add tests for basic XD functionality running on YARN, configure build-cycle execution and diagnostics, and validate behavior in the target environment.

Implement the RxJava processor module and adapter, define conversion between framework messages and RxJava streams, support processor configuration and lifecycle behavior, handle errors and completion, and add unit, integration, and module-level tests.

Expose the HttpChunkAggregator maximum message size through servers.yml, bind and validate the setting, preserve the current 1 MB default, wire it into HTTP server initialization, and add configuration and regression tests.

activities.activity_name: Cross-feature integration, regression testing, and delivery preparation
activities.activity_description: Run the full build and relevant integration and acceptance suites, diagnose interactions among the Reactor upgrade and new modules, fix regressions, update examples or build metadata as needed, and prepare the increment for delivery.
